### `POST /v1/actions/authorize`

**Authorize one action of an agent session** — operation `authorizeAction`

Credential: signing key

Authenticated like /sign (a tenant signing identity). The gateway assigns seq and prevActionHash and binds actionHash = SHA-256("QODIQA::ACTION::V2" \|\| JCS-P1({v, tenantId, agentId, sessionId, seq, tool{server,name,schemaHash}, args, parentRequestHash, prevActionHash})). The artifact lives at most 60 s and authorises exactly that action.

Request body (`application/json`, required): `ActionAuthorizeRequest`

| property | type | required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agentId` | string (uuid) | yes |
| `sessionId` | string (uuid) | yes |
| `tool` | object | yes |
| `args` | object | yes |
| `parentRequestHash` | string or null | no |
| `requestId` | string (uuid) | no |
| `proof` | string | no |
| `ttl` | integer | no |
| `planId` | string (uuid) | no |
| `delegationId` | string (uuid) | no |
| `approvalId` | string (uuid) | no |

Responses: `200` The action artifact · `202` The tool requires approval: an approval request was opened (or is still open); poll it, then call again with approvalId · `400` Invalid request, arguments refused by the registered schema (INVALID_REQUEST, ACTION_INVALID_TOOL, ACTION_INVALID_ARGS, ACTION_ARGS_INVALID) · `401` Signing credential or agent proof missing or invalid (UNAUTHORIZED, AGENT_PROOF_REQUIRED, AGENT_PROOF_INVALID) · `403` Refused (AGENT_SESSION_*, TOOL_NOT_REGISTERED, TOOL_PENDING_REVIEW, TOOL_DISABLED, ACTION_CLASS_NOT_ALLOWED, ACTION_PLAN_REQUIRED, ACTION_PLAN_UNKNOWN, ACTION_PLAN_EXPIRED, ACTION_NOT_IN_PLAN, APPROVAL_INVALID, APPROVAL_DENIED, APPROVAL_EXPIRED, APPROVAL_CANCELLED) · `409` The tool schema changed, the session chain moved, the session awaits an approval, or the approval was already used (TOOL_SCHEMA_CHANGED, ACTION_CHAIN_MISMATCH, SESSION_AWAITING_APPROVAL, APPROVAL_ALREADY_USED) · `429` The session action or cost budget, or the plan step, is exhausted (ACTION_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, COST_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, ACTION_PLAN_STEP_EXHAUSTED) · `503` Service is shutting down. ### `POST /v1/delegations`

**Issue a delegation** — operation `issueDelegation`

Credential: signing key

Authenticated like /sign. Without parentId this is a root grant (rights are a subset of the issuer's OWN classes); with parentId the issuer must be the delegate of that delegation and the child may only narrow it (classes, tools, maxActions, lifetime; depth is parent+1, never above the root's maxDepth; no agent twice in a chain). The issuance is itself an authorised action of the issuer session: class `delegate`, one place in the session chain and ledger.

Request body (`application/json`, required): `DelegationIssueRequest`

| property | type | required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `issuerAgentId` | string (uuid) | yes |
| `issuerSessionId` | string (uuid) | yes |
| `subjectAgentId` | string (uuid) | yes |
| `parentId` | string (uuid) | no |
| `classes` | array of string | yes |
| `tools` | array of object | no |
| `maxActions` | integer | no |
| `ttlSeconds` | integer | no |
| `maxDepth` | integer | no |
| `requestId` | string (uuid) | no |
| `proof` | string | no |

Responses: `201` The delegation and its signed token · `400` Invalid request (INVALID_REQUEST, INVALID_CLASSES, INVALID_TOOLS, INVALID_TTL, INVALID_MAX_DEPTH, INVALID_MAX_ACTIONS) · `401` Signing credential or agent proof missing or invalid (UNAUTHORIZED, AGENT_PROOF_REQUIRED, AGENT_PROOF_INVALID) · `403` Refused (DELEGATION_INVALID, DELEGATION_ATTENUATION_VIOLATION, DELEGATION_DEPTH_EXCEEDED, DELEGATION_CYCLE, DELEGATION_REVOKED, ACTION_CLASS_NOT_ALLOWED, AGENT_SESSION_*) · `404` No such delegation in this tenant (NOT_FOUND) · `409` The issuer session chain moved or is out of order (ACTION_CHAIN_MISMATCH, ACTION_ORDER_VIOLATION) · `429` The issuer session budget is exhausted (ACTION_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED) · `503` Service is shutting down. Returned by the request-drain middleware (`src/runtime/requestDrain.js`), mounted ahead of every route below, for all new requests received after graceful shutdown has begun. ### `POST /v1/delegations/{delegationId}/revoke`

**Revoke a delegation and everything below it** — operation `revokeDelegation`

Credential: signing key

Cascades to every descendant at once; the executions running under any of them are aborted (this process at once, other replicas at their next action: every authorisation and every execution re-checks the chain). Suspending or revoking an agent revokes the delegations it issued or holds.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `delegationId` | path | string (uuid) | yes | The delegation id |

| property | type | required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reason` | string | yes |
| `revokeAgents` | boolean | no |

The URL passes the SSRF policy of the model providers (https, no credentials, not an IP literal, not private / loopback / link-local / metadata); an https server must be registered with identity { kind: "tls-spki-pin", sha256 } - the SHA-256 of the certificate's public key (DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo) - and a connection whose key differs is dropped. http and local destinations exist only where QODIQA_MCP_ALLOW_LOCAL=true, never in production. There is no stdio transport.

### `POST /v1/tools/call`

**Call a tool through the gateway** — operation `callTool`

Credential: signing key

Authenticated like /sign. Runs ONE authorised action against a REGISTERED MCP server over HTTP (no stdio, no local execution): the artifact is verified, the actionHash is recomputed from this very call, the tool policy and the delegation chain are re-checked, the artifact is consumed once, the call goes out through the SSRF-guarded, pinned connection (no redirects, bounded time and size, abortable), the result is screened as untrusted content (encodings revealed, instruction conflict, semantic policy) and returned with its provenance and a receipt.

Request body (`application/json`, required): `ToolCallRequest`

| property | type | required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `artifact` | object | yes |
| `tool` | object | yes |
| `args` | object | yes |
| `parentRequestHash` | string or null | no |

Responses: `200` EXECUTE with the screened result, or a BLOCK when the result itself was withheld · `400` Invalid request or artifact (INVALID_REQUEST, ACTION_INVALID_TOOL, ACTION_ARGS_INVALID, WRONG_ARTIFACT_KIND, ACTION_ARTIFACT_INVALID) · `401` Credential or artifact signature invalid (UNAUTHORIZED, ACTION_SIGNATURE_INVALID) · `403` Refused (ACTION_TENANT_MISMATCH, AGENT_*, TOOL_*, MCP_SERVER_UNKNOWN / _DISABLED, MCP_URL_*, ACTION_POLICY_REQUIRED / _DENIED, DELEGATION_*, ACTION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED) · `409` The authorisation does not match this call or was already used, or the call was revoked while running (ACTION_MISMATCH, ACTION_REPLAY, ACTION_ORDER_VIOLATION, TOOL_SCHEMA_CHANGED, TOOL_REVOKED, MCP_SERVER_DISABLED, DELEGATION_REVOKED, AGENT_SESSION_KILLED) · `429` The per-tool limit of the session is used up (ACTION_TOOL_LIMIT) · `502` The MCP server failed or answered badly (TOOL_CALL_FAILED with details.code) · `503` Service is shutting down. Returned by the request-drain middleware (`src/runtime/requestDrain.js`), mounted ahead of every route below, for all new requests received after graceful shutdown has begun. In-flight requests are still allowed to complete. · `504` The MCP server did not answer in time (TOOL_CALL_FAILED, MCP_TIMEOUT)

## Artifact revocation

### `POST /v1/admin/artifact-revocations`

**Revoke one signed artifact before it is used** — operation `revokeArtifact`

Credential: operator key or ops token (deprecated)

Requires MANAGE_ARTIFACT_REVOCATIONS and an operator MFA step-up (X-QODIQA-OTP). A revoked artifact is refused (BLOCK ARTIFACT_REVOKED) after its signature and request binding are verified and before its nonce is consumed. The operator action is emitted at CRITICAL to the audit/SIEM stream; the BLOCK produced when the artifact is later presented is an ordinary audit-chain entry.

| parameter | in | type | required | description |

| `X-QODIQA-OTP` | header | string | yes | Operator MFA step-up code. Required when MFA is enforced (QODIQA_OPS_MFA_REQUIRED, mandatory in production). A TOTP code is accepted at most once per 30-second  |

| property | type | required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `requestId` | string (uuid) | yes |
| `reason` | string | yes |

### `GET /v1/admin/artifact-revocations/{requestId}`

**Is this artifact revoked?** — operation `getArtifactRevocation`

Credential: operator key or ops token (deprecated)

Requires MANAGE_ARTIFACT_REVOCATIONS. Revocations expire on their own (see ttlSeconds above); after that this reports revoked: false — by then the artifact itself is past its maximum age.

| parameter | in | type | required | description |

## Execution

### `POST /ai/chat`

**Execute AI request (enforcement)** — operation `executeAiChat`

Credential: none (public)

Execute an AI request through the QODIQA enforcement pipeline.  The enforcement pipeline performs: 1. Artifact signature verification (Ed25519) 2. Request binding validation 3. Nonce replay protection 4. Anomaly detection 5. Policy evaluation 6. AI provider execution (if allowed)  Returns `decision: "EXECUTE"`, or `decision: "BLOCK"` if any pipeline step rejects the request. In the default `decision` mode both are HTTP 200 (read `decision`, not the status); in the opt-in `status` mode a BLOCK carries its class status (400/403/409/429/500/503). Retrying with the same artifact after the nonce wa

| parameter | in | type | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x-qodiqa-artifact` | header | string | yes | Signed QODIQA artifact. Required. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string | no | Optional exactly-once retry token (docs/architecture/IDEMPOTENCY_KEY.md). Rejected with `stream: true` (`IDEMPOTENCY_STREAMING_UNSUPPORTED`). |

Request body (`application/json`, required): `AiChatRequest`

| property | type | required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `prompt` | string | no |
| `model` | string | no |
| `stream` | boolean | no |
| `provider` | string | no |
| `messages` | array of object | no |
| `system` | string | no |
| `purpose` | string | no |
| `dataRegion` | string | no |

Responses: `200` Enforcement decision. `decision: "EXECUTE"` (request executed), or — in the DEFAULT `decision` mode (QODIQA_BLOCK_HTTP_MODE unset or `decision`) — `decision: "BLOCK"` with the `reason` that stopped it. Clients MUST read `decision`; HTTP 200 alone does not mean the request executed. With `stream: true` an executing request answers `text/event-stream` instead (a BLOCK decided before the stream opens is still this JSON body). · `400` `status` mode only: enforcement BLOCK for a missing or unreadable artifact (MISSING_ARTIFACT, ARTIFACT_DECODE_FAILED, …). In both modes: request-body input-guard failures (canonical error envelope). · `403` `status` mode only (QODIQA_BLOCK_HTTP_MODE=status): enforcement BLOCK (`decision: "BLOCK"`) for an invalid artifact, request mismatch, anomaly, consent, policy, tenant/identity, semantic or output-limit reason. The `reason` field identifies the cause (docs/protocol/QODIQA-PROTOCOL.md). In the default mode these are HTTP 200. · `409` `REPLAY_DETECTED` (the artifact nonce was already used; `status` mode only — HTTP 200 in the default mode), or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT` / `IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS` (both modes: the `Idempotency-Key` was reused with a different request, or its first request is still running). · `413` Both modes: `ARTIFACT_TOO_LARGE` (the `x-qodiqa-artifact` header exceeds 8 KB) or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_TOO_LARGE` (the `Idempotency-Key` exceeds its length cap). · `415` Both modes: `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` — the request `Content-Type` is not `application/json`. · `422` Both modes: `AUDIT_UNREPRESENTABLE_TEXT` — the request or provider output contains a value the evidence stores cannot represent (U+0000, a lone surrogate); refused before any partial audit record is written. · `429` Too many requests. The body depends on the rate-limit bucket's configured envelope (src/core/rateLimit/middleware.js _deny429): management and legacyFailure buckets send the canonical error envelope; the protocol-decision bucket sends the BLOCK decision body; protocol buckets send the flat limiter body. · `500` Internal server error (src/api/response.js handleUnexpectedError; never the raw error message) · `502` Both modes: `PROVIDER_RESPONSE_INVALID` — the AI provider returned a response that could not be used. · `503` Service is shutting down. Returned by the request-drain middleware (`src/runtime/requestDrain.js`), mounted ahead of every route below, for all new requests received after graceful shutdown has begun. In-flight requests are still allowed to complete. · `504` Both modes: `PROVIDER_TIMEOUT`, `REQUEST_TIMEOUT` (the pipeline exceeded AI_CHAT_TIMEOUT_MS) or `PROVIDER_CANCELLED`. The outcome is unknown to the client; a retry needs a freshly signed artifact (an `Idempotency-Key` makes the retry exactly-once).

## Health

### `GET /health`

**Health check** — operation `getHealth`

Credential: optional (operator key or ops token (deprecated))

Returns the health status of the QODIQA service. Always returns 200 while the process is running — including during graceful shutdown — so orchestrators can distinguish "process alive" from "ready for traffic" (see /ready). Used by load balancers and orchestrators.

Responses: `200` Service is healthy · `401` Only when QODIQA_HEALTH_PROBE_AUTH_REQUIRED=true: missing or invalid ops credential. · `403` Only when QODIQA_HEALTH_REQUIRE_LOOPBACK=true: the caller is not on a loopback address ({decision:"BLOCK", reason:"FORBIDDEN"}), or the ops IP allow-list refused it.

### `GET /health/redis`

**Redis health check** — operation `getRedisHealth`

Credential: optional (operator key or ops token (deprecated))

Reports the health of the Redis-backed nonce/anomaly/rate-limit stores, independent of the main /health probe.

Responses: `200` Redis stores healthy, recovering or degraded · `401` Only when QODIQA_HEALTH_PROBE_AUTH_REQUIRED=true: missing or invalid ops credential. · `403` Only when QODIQA_HEALTH_REQUIRE_LOOPBACK=true: the caller is not on a loopback address ({decision:"BLOCK", reason:"FORBIDDEN"}), or the ops IP allow-list refused it. · `503` Redis disconnected

### `GET /ready`

**Readiness probe** — operation `getReadiness`

Credential: optional (operator key or ops token (deprecated))

Returns readiness status. Returns 503 during startup or graceful shutdown.

Responses: `200` Service is ready to accept traffic · `401` Only when QODIQA_HEALTH_PROBE_AUTH_REQUIRED=true: missing or invalid ops credential. · `403` Only when QODIQA_HEALTH_REQUIRE_LOOPBACK=true: the caller is not on a loopback address ({decision:"BLOCK", reason:"FORBIDDEN"}), or the ops IP allow-list refused it. · `503` Service is not ready to accept traffic — during startup (before dependencies are confirmed), after graceful shutdown begins, or when a mandatory runtime dependency (a Redis store, PostgreSQL when enabled, or the consent revocation subscriber) is unavailable (READY-50). Returned only by `GET /ready` (`src/api/routes/ready.js`); this readiness-probe contract is distinct from the `SERVICE_SHUTTING_DOWN` response returned by every other endpoint.

### `POST /key-admin/kek/rotate`

**Rotate the active KMS provider's wrapping key (KEK)** — operation `rotateKek`

Credential: operator key or ops token (deprecated)

Rotates the KMS provider's own wrapping key (KEK) — the key that encrypts artifact-signing private key material at rest. Distinct from POST /key-admin/{clientId}/rotate, which rotates an artifact signing key. Lock-protected — a concurrent KEK rotation is rejected with 409. Registered before /key-admin/{clientId}/rotate so a literal "kek" is never captured as {clientId}.

| parameter | in | type | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-QODIQA-OTP` | header | string | yes | Operator MFA step-up code. Required when MFA is enforced (QODIQA_OPS_MFA_REQUIRED, mandatory in production). A TOTP code is accepted at most once per 30-second  |

Responses: `200` Rotation result — new key material is encrypted under the new KEK going forward; existing keys.json ciphertext is unaffected until scripts/migrate-keys-json-kek.js is run · `400` Bad request — validation error or malformed input (canonical error envelope, src/api/response.js buildFailureBody) · `401` Unauthorized — missing or invalid operator credential (`UNAUTHORIZED`), or this mutation requires an operator MFA step-up code: no `X-QODIQA-OTP` header (`MFA_REQUIRED`) or a wrong/already-used code (`MFA_INVALID`, counts toward the lock). A TOTP code is accepted at most once per 30-second step. · `403` Forbidden — insufficient permissions (`FORBIDDEN`), or the operator has no MFA enrolled (`MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED`: POST /rbac/me/mfa/enroll, then POST /rbac/me/mfa/confirm). · `409` Conflict — resource already exists or state conflict · `429` Too many requests (see TooManyRequests), or MFA step-up locked after 5 failed codes in 15 minutes (`MFA_LOCKED`, canonical error envelope). Do not retry MFA_LOCKED before Retry-After. · `500` Internal server error (src/api/response.js handleUnexpectedError; never the raw error message) · `503` Service is shutting down. Returned by the request-drain middleware (`src/runtime/requestDrain.js`), mounted ahead of every route below, for all new requests received after graceful shutdown has begun. In-flight requests are still allowed to complete.

## Proofs

### `GET /v1/proofs/{requestId}`

**Downloadable proof of one request** — operation `getRequestProof`

Credential: operator key or ops token (deprecated)

Requires READ_AUDIT_PROOFS (auditor, compliance, admin); no MFA step-up (read only); every read is logged. Assembles the audit entries of the request, the contiguous chain path to the earliest signed checkpoint that covers them, the transparency leaf with its inclusion proof and signed root, the receipt, the external anchors and the public keys. The gateway does not store the signed artifact: add it when verifying (qodiqa-proof-verify --artifact). Every part that cannot be assembled is left out and the verifier lowers its verdict accordingly.

| parameter | in | type | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `requestId` | path | string (uuid) | yes | The payload.requestId of the consumed artifact (a UUID). Knowing it is the only authorization for this endpoint. |
| `tenantId` | query | string | yes | The tenant that owns the request; a request of another tenant is indistinguishable from an unknown one (404) |
| `fullChain` | query | boolean | no | true: also serve the contiguous platform chain path, which contains OTHER tenants' raw entries; needs READ_AUDIT_PROOFS_FULL_CHAIN (admin). Without it the path  |

Responses: `200` The proof qodiqa-proof/1 of the request · `400` Bad request — validation error or malformed input (canonical error envelope, src/api/response.js buildFailureBody) · `401` Unauthorized — missing or invalid operator credential (src/middleware/opsAuth.js → failure()) · `403` Forbidden — insufficient permissions (src/middleware/rbac.js → failure()) · `404` Not found — resource does not exist · `500` Internal server error (src/api/response.js handleUnexpectedError; never the raw error message) · `503` Service is shutting down. ### `POST /v1/admin/providers`

**Register an OpenAI-compatible provider (compat-<id>)** — operation `registerProvider`

Credential: operator key or ops token (deprecated)

Requires MANAGE_PROVIDERS and an operator MFA step-up (X-QODIQA-OTP). The key is never sent here: apiKeyEnv names an environment variable (COMPAT_KEY_*) provisioned on every replica. baseUrl must be https to a public DNS name; a record changed outside the API is not callable (MAC).

| parameter | in | type | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-QODIQA-OTP` | header | string | yes | Operator MFA step-up code. Required when MFA is enforced (QODIQA_OPS_MFA_REQUIRED, mandatory in production). A TOTP code is accepted at most once per 30-second  |

Request body (`application/json`, required): `ProviderRegistryInput`

| property | type | required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes |
| `displayName` | string | no |
| `baseUrl` | string | yes |
| `apiKeyEnv` | string | no |
| `models` | array of string | no |
| `defaultModel` | string | no |
| `timeoutMs` | integer | no |
| `maxTokens` | integer | no |
| `failoverProvider` | string | no |
| `enabled` | boolean | no |

Responses: `201` Registered · `400` Bad request — validation error or malformed input (canonical error envelope, src/api/response.js buildFailureBody) · `401` Unauthorized — missing or invalid operator credential (`UNAUTHORIZED`), or this mutation requires an operator MFA step-up code: no `X-QODIQA-OTP` header (`MFA_REQUIRED`) or a wrong/already-used code (`MFA_INVALID`, counts toward the lock). A TOTP code is accepted at most once per 30-second step. · `403` Forbidden — insufficient permissions (`FORBIDDEN`), or the operator has no MFA enrolled (`MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED`: POST /rbac/me/mfa/enroll, then POST /rbac/me/mfa/confirm). · `409` Conflict — resource already exists or state conflict · `429` Too many requests (see TooManyRequests), or MFA step-up locked after 5 failed codes in 15 minutes (`MFA_LOCKED`, canonical error envelope). Do not retry MFA_LOCKED before Retry-After. · `500` Internal server error (src/api/response.js handleUnexpectedError; never the raw error message) · `503` Service is shutting down. Returned by the request-drain middleware (`src/runtime/requestDrain.js`), mounted ahead of every route below, for all new requests received after graceful shutdown has begun. In-flight requests are still allowed to complete.

## Signing

### `POST /sign`

**Sign request** — operation `signRequest`

Credential: signing key

Generate a signed artifact for a request.  Refusals are BLOCK decision bodies (`DecisionBlock`). A 503 is either the shutdown-drain body or, when the signing key or the policy set is unavailable, a `DecisionBlock` with reason `KEY_UNAVAILABLE` or `POLICY_UNAVAILABLE`.  The artifact can then be passed as `x-qodiqa-artifact` when executing via `/ai/chat` or verified independently via `/verify`.  Requires `Authorization: Bearer <signing-api-key>` — a per-identity credential issued via `POST /signing-identities/{id}/api-key` (TRUST-1 remediation; there is no shared signing secret). The authenticat

Request body (`application/json`, required): `SignRequest`

| property | type | required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `request` | object | yes |
| `payload` | object | no |
| `v2` | object | no |
| `ttl` | number | no |

Responses: `200` Signed artifact · `400` Invalid sign request (INVALID_REQUEST, PROVIDER_REQUIRED, PROVIDER_NOT_SUPPORTED, PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED) · `401` Signing credential missing, unknown or expired (UNAUTHORIZED, API_KEY_EXPIRED) · `403` Signing identity not permitted (SCOPE_PROVIDER_DENIED, SCOPE_ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH, …) · `429` Too many requests. The body depends on the rate-limit bucket's configured envelope (src/core/rateLimit/middleware.js _deny429): management and legacyFailure buckets send the canonical error envelope; the protocol-decision bucket sends the BLOCK decision body; protocol buckets send the flat limiter body. · `500` Signing failed (SIGNING_FAILED) · `503` Service is shutting down. Returned by the request-drain middleware (`src/runtime/requestDrain.js`), mounted ahead of every route below, for all new requests received after graceful shutdown has begun. In-flight requests are still allowed to complete.

## Single sign-on

### `POST /auth/ldap/login`

**LDAP / Active Directory password sign-in: the directory proves the password, the linked operator account gets a session token** — operation `ldapLogin`

Credential: none (public)

Only when the provider is configured (QODIQA_LDAP_CONFIG_PATH). The (provider, directory subject) must be linked to an enabled operator account (no automatic account creation); every refusal (wrong password, unknown user, not linked, disabled, locked after 5 failures in 15 minutes, not in a required group) is the same generic 401. 503 LOGIN_UNAVAILABLE when the directory or identity store cannot be reached. Strictly rate limited per client address. The token (Bearer qos1...) is accepted by the admin API.

Request body (`application/json`, required): object

| property | type | required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | string | yes |
| `username` | string | yes |
| `password` | string | yes |

Responses: `200` Operator session · `400` Bad request — validation error or malformed input (canonical error envelope, src/api/response.js buildFailureBody) · `401` Unauthorized — missing or invalid operator credential (src/middleware/opsAuth.js → failure()) · `404` Not found — resource does not exist · `429` Too many requests. The body depends on the rate-limit bucket's configured envelope (src/core/rateLimit/middleware.js _deny429): management and legacyFailure buckets send the canonical error envelope; the protocol-decision bucket sends the BLOCK decision body; protocol buckets send the flat limiter body.

### `POST /auth/saml/acs`

**SAML assertion consumer service: the response of the identity provider (form post) becomes an operator session token** — operation `samlAcs`

Credential: none (public)

application/x-www-form-urlencoded SAMLResponse + RelayState. The assertion must be signed by a pinned IdP certificate, answer THIS login (signed relay state), be unused (replay guard) and name a subject linked to an enabled operator account; every refusal is the same generic 401. 503 LOGIN_UNAVAILABLE when the identity or replay store cannot be reached. The token (Bearer qos1...) is accepted by the admin API.

| parameter | in | type | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | query | string | yes | SAML provider id from QODIQA_SAML_CONFIG_PATH |

Responses: `200` Operator session · `400` Bad request — validation error or malformed input (canonical error envelope, src/api/response.js buildFailureBody) · `401` Unauthorized — missing or invalid operator credential (src/middleware/opsAuth.js → failure()) · `404` Not found — resource does not exist · `429` Too many requests. The body depends on the rate-limit bucket's configured envelope (src/core/rateLimit/middleware.js _deny429): management and legacyFailure buckets send the canonical error envelope; the protocol-decision bucket sends the BLOCK decision body; protocol buckets send the flat limiter body.

Only when the provider is configured (QODIQA_SAML_CONFIG_PATH): the answer is a 302 to the identity provider (an unconfigured provider is 404). 503 LOGIN_UNAVAILABLE when the identity or replay store cannot be reached. Rate limited per client address.

| parameter | in | type | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | query | string | yes | SAML provider id from QODIQA_SAML_CONFIG_PATH |

## Verification

### `POST /v1/verify`

**Verify artifact (v1)** — operation `verifyArtifactV1`

Credential: none (public)

Verify a signed artifact without executing the underlying request.  Performs the complete 5-step verification pipeline in dry-run mode: 1. Ed25519 signature verification 2. Request binding verification 3. Nonce check (dry-run, no state write) 4. Anomaly detection (dry-run) 5. Policy evaluation  Returns HTTP 200 with `decision: "EXECUTE"` or `decision: "BLOCK"`. No AI provider is called.

Request body (`application/json`, required): `VerifyRequest`

| property | type | required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `artifact` | `Artifact` | yes |
| `request` | object | yes |

Responses: `200` Verification result · `400` Bad request — validation error or malformed input (canonical error envelope, src/api/response.js buildFailureBody) · `429` Too many requests. The body depends on the rate-limit bucket's configured envelope (src/core/rateLimit/middleware.js _deny429): management and legacyFailure buckets send the canonical error envelope; the protocol-decision bucket sends the BLOCK decision body; protocol buckets send the flat limiter body. · `500` Internal server error (src/api/response.js handleUnexpectedError; never the raw error message) · `503` Service is shutting down. Returned by the request-drain middleware (`src/runtime/requestDrain.js`), mounted ahead of every route below, for all new requests received after graceful shutdown has begun. In-flight requests are still allowed to complete.
